description.en-US: *Draw nigh, draw nigh, Emmanuel* — the Advent hymn that gathers the great O Antiphons into one cry for the coming of the Saviour.
description.pt-BR: *Ó vem, ó vem, Emmanuel* — o hino do Advento que reúne as grandes Antífonas do Ó num só clamor pela vinda do Salvador.

history.en-US: The verses paraphrase the O Antiphons sung at Vespers from 17 to 23 December; the hymn first appears in the *Psalteriolum Cantionum Catholicarum* (Cologne, 1710), and J. M. Neale put it into English in 1851.
history.pt-BR: As estrofes parafraseiam as Antífonas do Ó, cantadas nas Vésperas de 17 a 23 de dezembro; o hino aparece pela primeira vez no *Psalteriolum Cantionum Catholicarum* (Colônia, 1710), e J. M. Neale o verteu para o inglês em 1851.

source.en-US: Latin and English (J. M. Neale): *A Manual of Prayers for the Use of the Catholic Laity* (Baltimore, 1889), "Advent Hymn", pp. 602–603 — [Wikisource](https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/A_Manual_of_Prayers_for_the_Use_of_the_Catholic_Laity/Hymns_and_Sequences/Advent_Hymn)
